qualification: Ground joins at the extended mapped parking, grass, paths and complete canopy extent. Retained source heights within1.25m ofDGM and source slopes<=0.7 are accepted. Isolated returns whose available immediate neighbours all differ by more than0.25m vertically are rejected. Missing source returns remain explicit. Short bounded missing runs may use explicitly recorded interpolated residuals; raw delta and sourceHeightMC remain null at those points. Candidate35 preserves every remaining source sample exactly; only controls on the two filled enclosed boundaries are removed.
coordinateSystem: EPSG:25832; residual metres sourceMC.y minus DGM1 MC.y

gapInterpolation.qualification: Linear interpolation of residuals across short bounded gaps using neighbouring accepted ground. These are estimated joining heights, not provider observations. Longer gaps and abrupt residual differences remain unresolved.
